definition: unusually great in size or extent
description: A young man with curly hair and a light blue and white striped scarf walks along a colourful street, then sits at a shaded outdoor table drinking from a mate gourd through a metal straw. The clip then cuts to him standing alone at a viewing railing in front of an enormous wall of blue glacier ice that fills the whole frame behind him and stretches out of shot on both sides. He is tiny against it, and he throws both arms out wide.
